subject: lavaan.survey with FIML (Estimators for complex samples and behaviour of Fit indices)

messages.author: b8df699223c6b229
messages.subject: lavaan.survey with FIML (Estimators for complex samples and behaviour of Fit indices)
parts:
Hi all,

i am conducting multiple multi-group CFA to test for general fit and measurement invariance. Because i have to handle missingness i would like to imply FIML using lavaan.survey.


As far as i am concerned the only valid (functional) estimator for a fit object from lavaan in lavaan.survey is the MLMVS. My problem comes with the behaviour of the fit indices (and a great deal of "still not knowing"...).

After calculation there comes a problem with the fit indices. If i use the MLSMV (for listwise or ml) the CFI drops significantly (.95 to .23 for FIML and MLMVS and .95 to .19 for listwise and MLMVS). All other indices remain good to ok (TLI, RMSEA, SRMR) - but my Tests on Measurement Invariance rely on the Delta-CFI...

After testing alternative settings it seems to me that whenever i include a variance adjusted test statistic especially the CFI drops.

So i am unclear on two points:
Is the MLMVS is a valid choice for this at all? (...in fact i am still unclear on the Satterthwaite correction and the variance adjustment...)
Is the drop of the CFI ((d0-d1)/d0) a problem of the CFI  in this scenarion or does it indicate problems within my data that i have to account for? (i thought of problems within the cfi because the tli (using ratios of chi^2/df not d=chi^2-df) does not behave that way).

Any ideas would be highly appreciated!
(and many thanks for the two packages in the first place!)




Code:

class <- svydesign(ids=~idclass, Nest=TRUE,prob=~1,data=x) # Designobject

#Simplified Modell
modell<-
'kman=~kmanag1sr+kmanag9sr+kmanag10sr+kmanag11sr
diag=~diag13sr+diag14sr+diag15sr+diag17sr'

fit<-cfa(modell, data=x, group = "Kl", missing='direct') #fitting in lavaan
fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit, class, estimator="MLMVS") #fitting in lavaan.survey


I found some hintes here, but it remained unclear to me whether the MLMVS is valid here.
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/lavaan/lavaan.survey/lavaan/K0P4tmIt3eE/Au1Y148VjUQJ
